name: Local improvement district special assessment
legal_base: RCW 35.43 (city LIDs for transportation and infrastructure purposes RCW 35.43.030)
who_can_create: City or town (e.g. City of Seattle); RCW 81.112.070 does not give Sound Transit LID powers
base: Special benefit to each parcel (land value gain attributable to the improvement)
rate_basis: Share of special benefit assessed; one-time charge payable in installments
key_limits: Assessment may not exceed special benefit; owners subject to 60% or more of total cost can stop formation by protest within 30 days (RCW 35.43.180)
collection_path: King County Treasury with property tax bill; installments over 10-30 years

name: Tax increment area
who_can_create: Local government designates the area (RCW 39.114.020); Sound Transit status as 'local government' not verified
base: Assessed value growth above the base year in the area
rate_basis: Regular property tax levies on increment value, excluding state school levy, school excess and EMS levies, and port/PUD debt levies (RCW 39.114.050(1)(c))
key_limits: Area AV at most $200M or 20% of sponsor's AV, whichever is less (RCW 39.114.020(1)(c)(i)); at most two active areas per sponsor (1)(d); sunset at most 25 years after first collection (1)(e)
approval: Ordinance after at least two public hearings (RCW 39.114.020(8)(a)); no voter approval
collection_path: County treasurer apportions increment to sponsor (RCW 39.114.050)

name: One-time betterment levy (general)
source: Not a separate instrument in Washington; LID special assessment is the closest
